import torch, torch.nn as nn, os
from model import MLP
from data import make_data


def train(model, train_loader, val_loader, n_epochs=20, lr=1e-3, patience=3, checkpoint_path="checkpoint.pt"):
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
    loss_fn = nn.MSELoss()
    if os.path.exists(checkpoint_path):
        model.load_state_dict(torch.load(checkpoint_path))   # only weights restored
    best = float("inf"); no_improve = 0
    for epoch in range(n_epochs):                            # always starts at 0 on resume
        model.train()
        for x, y in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad(); loss = loss_fn(model(x), y); loss.backward(); optimizer.step()
        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val = sum(loss_fn(model(x), y).item() for x, y in val_loader)
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), checkpoint_path)      # only model.state_dict()
        print(f"epoch {epoch:02d} | val {val:.4f}")
        if val < best: best = val; no_improve = 0
        else: no_improve += 1
        if no_improve >= patience: break
    return model
